name: Centum Intake Module
description: Scans and imports uploaded RFQ files (BOM zip/Excel) from the upload_server staging area into the RFQ workflow.

tools.name: centum_intake__scan_local_file
tools.description: Scan the local staged upload area for an RFQ's uploaded files and register them in the workflow.

tools.name: centum_intake__import_bom
tools.description: Import and validate the BOM file for one rfq_id from the staged upload area into the intake pipeline.
